summary: Remote-controlled shell backdoor driven by memory.whalent.com WebSocket gateway
details: @whalent/agent-core@0.3.235 ships a ~5.3 MB single-line string-array-obfuscated bundle at dist/index.cjs (obfuscator.io-style rotated string array a0_0x4f63 with hex-mangled identifiers throughout). The bundle opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded gateway (https://memory.whalent.com/pt, overridable via WHALENT_GATEWAY), imports node-pty, and spawns /bin/sh, cmd.exe, or powershell driven by bytes received from that gateway — giving whoever controls the gateway interactive shell/PTY execution on the installer's host. The bundle also contains an npmInstall helper wired to WHALENT_NPM_REGISTRY / NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY, and the README states the package 'is the package replaced by remote daemon upgrades', so the gateway operator can additionally rotate the code executed on the host by pushing new @whalent/agent-core versions. The whole-runtime string-array obfuscation of a package that exposes a remote-shell code path is not a bundling/minification pattern and materially blocks review of the shell dispatch path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
